recentItems.title: Gqeberha-born Jae-Leigh Filander realises cricketing dream
recentItems.description:
Gqeberha-born cricketer, Jae-Leigh Filander used the Cricket South Africa (CSA) development pathway to realise her dream of playing international cricket.

Filander is a wicketkeeper-batter for the Western Province Cobras.Last Thursday, she won her first cap for the Proteas when she was selected to face Zimbabwe in the fourth T20 International in Bulawayo.

The Proteas went on to beat their neighbours, 5-nil in the series, and uncovered the next generation of internationals, like Filander, in the process.

SABC News sports reporter Simon Burke filed this story.

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Ekurhuleni Murders | Police link ninth victim to love triangle
recentItems.description:
DEVELOPING: 

Deputy National Police Commissioner Lt-Gen Tebello Mosikili says the murder of Jabulile Ntimba may be linked to a love triangle, cautioning that investigators have not yet concluded that the case is the work of a serial killer.

Ntimba was the ninth woman found among recent murders across Ekurhuleni since July, but the SAPS has indicated that her murder is currently not being linked to the other eight case

Members of the Gauteng Murder and Robbery Unit arrested three suspects one man and two women over the weekend. The trio is scheduled to appear in the Boksburg Magistrate's Court today.

recentItems.title: Moroka dam body discovery heightens Soweto safety concerns
recentItems.description:
{WARNING: GRAPHIC CONTENT}

The Urban Inspector for Ward 33, Dorah Ralehoma, says Soweto residents are increasingly concerned about their safety. 

This follows the discovery of a woman's body in a dam in Moroka on Sunday. Ralehoma says this is not the first body to be found in the area, with similar incidents reported nearby. 

She says residents are calling for increased police and JMPD visibility to prevent the area from becoming a dumping ground. 

SABC News reporter Thabiso Radebe has more details from Moroka, in Soweto.

recentItems.title: Sheila Mabale-Huma refutes allegations that she is supporting and funding the SLK Independent Party
recentItems.description:
The ANC Bojanala Regional Chairperson Sheila Mabale-Huma has refuted allegations that she is supporting and funding the SLK Independent Party. 

The allegations surfaced over the weekend, insinuating that Huma is giving the SLK Independent Party resources to campaign. The allegations have raised questions about the party's possible political motives and potential impact on the ANC.

recentItems.title: An alleged serial rapist appeared at the Durban Magistrate's court
recentItems.description:
KwaZulu Natal Premier Mr Thami Ntuli was at the Durban Magistrate's court where an alleged serial rapist charged with the raping 16 women in Cato Manor, Durban made his first appearance.
